collectionNotes: Mechanical cases were collected by issue17_controls.py, then admittedProductSubmissions were appended through the same admitted_case helper without repeating unchanged mechanical runs.

During mechanics collection, test helper/leaf files received formatting/import ordering only. Sources hashes identify final reviewable files; they are not a claim that every earlier process loaded these exact formatted bytes. The admitted cases used the final formatted helper and leaf.

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=implement. Graph-authorized candidate mutation from admitted B1/C0. Implement the frozen Contract in the current candidate workspace. Return null on completed mutation; worker labels and claims confer no candidate identity or semantic authority.
children.name: implement

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=initial_evidence_check. Read-only required-evidence role. Check required material for the current stable candidate under the frozen Contract; missing required raw material must signal missing.
children.name: initial_evidence_check

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=initial_review. Independent read-only review of the stable current candidate and available required evidence under the frozen Contract. Return actual findings in findingContent and clean/found as the canonical review signal. Findings confer no correction or acceptance authority.
children.name: initial_review

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=adjudicate_authority. Read-only designated adjudication authority. Assess actual findingContent against the frozen Contract, stable candidate and required evidence. Signal open_d1 only with the applicable directive and correction content in directiveContent; signal none only with no unresolved directive. Payload text and diagnostic identifiers do not confer routing authority.
children.name: adjudicate_authority

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=final_assessment_authority_clean. Read-only designated final semantic authority. Assess the complete frozen Contract against the stable current candidate, available required evidence and applicable directives. Clean review alone is insufficient. Signal gap for insufficient evidence or unresolved correction, refused for an authority question, and accepted only for criterion-level semantic satisfaction.
children.name: final_assessment_authority_clean

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=repair. Graph-authorized candidate mutation. Repair the current candidate using only the frozen Contract and adjudicated directive/correction content. Do not treat raw/rejected findings as directives or discharge your own obligation. Return null on completed mutation.
children.name: repair

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=repair_evidence_check. Read-only required-evidence role. Check required material for the current stable candidate under the frozen Contract; missing required raw material must signal missing.
children.name: repair_evidence_check

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=repair_review. Independent read-only review of the stable current candidate and available required evidence under the frozen Contract. Return actual findings in findingContent and clean/found as the canonical review signal. Findings confer no correction or acceptance authority.
children.name: repair_review

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=resolution_authority. Read-only designated resolution authority. Assess fresh findings, current candidate and evidence against the outstanding adjudicated directive and correction. A clean review or worker claim does not resolve it. Signal resolved_d1 only on explicit supported resolution; otherwise retain open_d1. The directive payload persists unchanged through the loop.
children.name: resolution_authority

otherwise.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=round_complete. Read-only required round control. Signal completed.
otherwise.name: round_complete

children.instructions: BROODLING_NODE=final_assessment_authority_repaired. Read-only designated final semantic authority. Assess the complete frozen Contract against the stable current candidate, available required evidence and applicable directives. Clean review alone is insufficient. Signal gap for insufficient evidence or unresolved correction, refused for an authority question, and accepted only for criterion-level semantic satisfaction.
children.name: final_assessment_authority_repaired

scope.controlledLeafLimit: The fixture records sandbox arguments but does not enforce containment or establish model judgment; historical W2/W4 supplies those qualified boundaries.
scope.testGraphDeviations: Only two hang cases shorten the selected node timeout to250ms, and the explicitly named widened-binding-canary adds a forbidden raw-finding repair input to test detector sensitivity. Other cases execute the exact product graph.
